title: Revision: Supervised and Unsupervised Learning
status: Draft practice quiz — teacher review required
instructions: Ten questions drawn from the worked examples in the Course and Laboratory. Some questions require selecting all correct answers. Exact matches earn one point.

questions.prompt: Which task has NO known class labels during training?
options: Grouping five delivery coordinates using K-means
Using KNN to classify a labelled player
Checking whether a prediction matches a true class
questions.explanation: K-means uses numerical data without supplied target classes.

questions.prompt: The 12-row diary has six yes and six no labels. What is its binary entropy?
questions.explanation: Balanced binary outcomes have entropy 1 bit.

questions.prompt: Sky creates three four-row groups with entropies 0, 1, and 0. What is the weighted entropy after splitting?
questions.explanation: Each branch gets weight 4/12, so the sum is 1/3.

questions.prompt: What is the information gain of the Sky question?
K-means first groups A(-1,0), B(1,0), C(0,1). What is their mean?
What happened to J in the Ciortuz five-point example after recomputing means?
questions.explanation: The new within-cluster squared error is 19/6≈3.167.

options: Three nearest labelled training records vote
questions.explanation: KNN counts nearby labelled examples, unlike K-means which specifies cluster count.

questions.prompt: Given TP=2, TN=2, FP=1 and FN=1, what is accuracy?
questions.explanation: Four of six predictions were correct: (TP+TN)/N=4/6.

questions.prompt: Which statements about a six-example test are defensible?
options: It is useful for practising a confusion matrix
It cannot establish reliable real-world accuracy
It proves the model will generalise forever
It can replace collecting more diverse test records
questions.explanation: A tiny test is a teaching aid, not a strong estimate of deployment performance.

questions.prompt: Which procedures require labelled training examples?
questions.explanation: ID3 and KNN are supervised; K-means is unsupervised.
